searchText: Hi guys, a little late, but setting up a validator today... Think I can just run ubuntu off a usb, or do I have to try to make my bootloader add a 3rd option? I hate boot loaders I don't want to try to set it up on kali as Im not convinced it'll work, and windows is out XD not quite the place to ask this, but you should *actually* install ubuntu server on the host drives instead of messing with nonstandard boot configs if you are on linux anyways just install docker and use containers. That will keep your host system clean pretty much What are we calling the execution chain? Post merge, Ethereum will have two chains. Beacon chain and ??? chain. I've seen "consensus chain" and "execution chain", with "beacon" being used in place of consensus now and again. These seem to be suitably descriptive (consensus chain used to come to consensus, execution chain used for execution of transactions), although it may be slightly less so once we have sharding. This also maps to the general uses of the term consensus layer and execution layer. OG chain Aeacon chain I would love to see us standardize on those names, rather than "beacon" (which isn't immediately clear to new users). Lighthouse is providing support for Ropsten via a *release-candidate*. We had to make a last-minute-fix to a recent fork-choice spec change so we weren't comfortable promoting it for mainnet use yet. We'll follow up with a proper release next week. Regardless, `v2.3.0-rc.0` is good to go for Ropsten and has binaries available for download. Get it whilst it's hot: https://github.com/sigp/lighthouse/releases/tag/v2.3.0-rc.0 Is the robsten merge still due for the 8 of June, because wenmerge.com states 21 days? Yes, it is June 8th. I wouldn't pay heed to #s or times on that website and instead advise you (and others) to focus on announcements from ACD. Execution/consensus layer? Looking for a name for the blockchains specifically. Execution/Consensus chain works for me. I would rather not Execution/Beacon chain though. I liked Aeacon/Beacon chain suggestion above if we want to go with the beacon chain naming. 😆 Akon & Bacon sounds even better 🙂 considering how much we have talked about EL&CL, I would advocate for EC and CC respectively to eliminate any confusion. Unless of course we are going to have multiple EC and CC. "conchain" & "exechain" ? EC would be "Execution Client" to me. I also kind of dislike the potential inference of there being two separate chains still with "Execution Chain" and "Consensus Chain". To some extent that is indeed the case, but I'd say there being _one_ chain (with a consensus layer, an execution layer, and also L2 layers on top of the latter) is more accurate. see the confusion here about different notions of block number across the chains though they are distinct. block numbers? I thought the beacon chain only had slot numbers sure, the terminology is different, but there's been confusion even in this channel about, generically, the coordinate systems not overlapping between the two chains. also, that they are distinct chains means that there exist failure modes (in theory, with ethereum nodes complying with relevant specifications, should be avoided, but a true single chain would not have them at all) where there's divergence. the end-user communication part involves communicating about sync progress. again, it'll be two chains and it'll behave like it. Fair enough, but I feel it very much depends from what perspective you looking at "the chain(s)". A user interacting with Ethereum now won't notice there being another chain after the merge, and the notion of another chain would be rather confusing to them. For node operators/those running clients, many are already accustomed to "beacon chain", let alone the pieces of software referred to as "beacon node" and "validator client" on the consensus side. We're a bit weird in that we do actually only have a single chain of blocks, but two separate states (execution and consensus) that come from it. None of the names are 100% accurate, and I don't think any name will make everyone happy, so we may as well pick one of the current crop of names for the consensus side (either beacon or consensus chain, I prefer the latter but not enough to fight about it) and stick with execution on the old ETH1 side. I have no issue adopting consensus chain as a synonym (or replacement of) of beacon chain, but that rename is not going to magically make everything clearer I'm afraid. yeah, that's fine IMO, "legacy" names will stick around for a while, not much you can do about it 🤷 one thing I like about execution/consensus is it makes it easy to then add "data" when sharding gets here but the one really awkward thing is I can imagine renaming "execution" to, say, "settlement" in a world where most activity is on L2s 😅 We are going to try to have bopsten.beaconcha.in live by next friday — huge thanks to <@199561711278227457> for his merge-explorer PR 😇 we can't even control _current_ names 😛 hey guys, where can I get some Ropsten test eth for the upcoming merge? https://faucetlink.to/ropsten nvm 🙂 ty Could we please please please call it `ropsten.beaconcha.in`? It's `--network ropsten` to configure the CL. at the very least, alias it 🙂
